result: After resolving the collapsed contour boundary, the source scalar density has universal normal order -1. The collision-normal Jacobian d(A-B)=u*d(xi) cancels it, so the strict-transformed integration current has order zero. Its leading coefficient depends on xi,B,C and d but not on the exceptional ratio t. The first correction depends polynomially on t, but its only new denominator is the t-independent exceptional branch polynomial Phi. Therefore the exceptional Cayley-Menger current introduces no finite t-puncture through first correction beyond the coefficient poles t=+1 and t=-1.
qualification: This is the first exceptional current. It does not prove absence of higher-normal or distributional t-support, nor path independence of the transported relative-cycle class.
